title: Holidays Consolidated Fixture (block-centric canonical view)
description:
Schema for each pilot's holidays-consolidated.json. The block-centric companion to calendar/*.json: every multi-day holiday block is declared ONCE here with its start+end + category, instead of being re-derived from the per-day events scattered across the monthly calendar files. The C1.7 loader's `expandHolidays(pilot)` query reads this file; `eventsOnDate(pilot, date)` reads calendar/*.json. The C1.5 spec asserts the two views agree (every block's expanded range matches the per-day events with that blockId).

Categories match the C1.1 calendar-fixture schema enum (minus 'academic', which doesn't apply to holidays): national, religious, school_specific.

academicYearId.description: Cross-references the AY this list belongs to (matches academic-structure.json's academicYearId).

blocks.description: Multi-day holiday blocks. May be empty. Each entry expands to (endBsDate - startBsDate + 1) days inclusive.

singleDayHolidays.description: Standalone single-day holidays. May be empty. Each entry is exactly one BS calendar day.

HolidayCategory.description: Matches the C1.1 calendar-fixture metadata.category enum (minus 'academic' which doesn't apply to holidays).

id.description: Kebab-case slug. Referenced by calendar/*.json events as metadata.blockId.

endBsDate.description: Inclusive end. start == end means a 1-day block (uncommon — prefer singleDayHolidays for that case).

source.description: Optional provenance hint for operators. Not consumed by code.
